showD: Turn each kind on or off. Some have an amount right under them: that amount decides when the alert shows. You see alerts on the Alerts page and at the top of Home.

types.jars: Payments that look like they came from a jar
types.card: Card charge much higher than last month
types.recon: Books do not match the bank
types.sync: A source is out of date

mistakeD: Brings back every alert you dismissed.
